title: Story premise EDU006: The Fair-Share Seesaw
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: What number can stand in for all three piles? Takeaway/theme: The arithmetic mean is the total divided by the number of values.
description: Three islanders want an equal pile of stones, but their piles contain two, four, and nine. A transfer machine redistributes the fifteen stones into three piles of five and balances their platform.
